provenance.how: constructed from the ADR's literals at the pinned ref and cross-checked against the core's own builders (tests/unit/mobile/test_push_wire_contract.py); not captured from a running relay, because no relay route emits the machine-side shapes yet

notes: The attention form is NOT the completion form with a flag: no conversation, no completion_token and no kind, because a tap on an attention push must not deep-link anywhere — it is a badge correction.

NO alert, and the absence is the rule rather than an omission: the attention push is a silent, best-effort wake (§3.2), so it has no title and no body to show — a badge correction that raised a banner would interrupt a user to tell them nothing they asked for. alert is present on completion and digest and must not appear here (absent_fields).

exclude names the device that just acted, so the self-correcting push skips it. It is OPTIONAL and absent means 'exclude nobody', which is what a tick-detected change sends because it never knows who acknowledged — see exclude_absent_payload, which is a whole valid payload and not an empty list.
An attention emit is keyed on the machine's emit SEQUENCE, never on a completion key (emit-idempotency-keys.json): an ack is not a heal.
On a phone this arrives as a silent, best-effort wake; the type is what stops the tap asking for a conversation that the payload never named.
